Default code language annotation on blocks without lang attribute

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		CodeLanguage: `python`,
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<pre><code>def hello(): pass</code></pre>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
